_noteP: Echoing Flames (UrgotPassiveAbility/UrgotPassive in urgot.bin.json). Live wiki text (2026-07-10 fetch): 'Urgot's next basic attack within the arc of a shotgun ... dealing 40% - 100% (based on level) AD (+ 2% - 6% (based on level) of target's maximum health) physical damage to enemies hit, capped at 100 - 390.59 (based on level) against monsters.' The BIN has TWO separate calcs for this, not one: (1) ADDamage = StatBySubPartCalculationPart(mStat=2 TOTAL AD x ByCharLevelBreakpoints(Level1Value=0.40, +0.12 one-off bumps at levels 6/9/11/13/15 -> 100% total AD from level 15 on)) -- already correctly curated in the prior pass. (2) PercentHPRatio = ByCharLevelBreakpoints(Level1Value=0.02, +0.01 one-off bumps at levels 6/9/11/13 -> 0.06 at level 13+), a %maxHP fraction that lives only inside a GameCalculation formula tree with no matching DataValues array entry -- resolved via hpPercentCalc (the Skarner-P-style mechanism), hpBasis Max. CORRECTION vs the prior pass: it only captured (1) and silently dropped (2), understating Echoing Flames' true damage. MonsterCap (ByCharLevelInterpolation 100->360) is a vs-monster-only damage cap, not curated (this combo tool is player-vs-player). Trigger mechanic: each of Urgot's 6 shotguns covers a 60-degree arc and fires once on his next basic attack within that arc before going on its own per-leg cooldown (30/20/10/5/2.5s by level) -- approximated as a P bonusEffect firing on every basic attack (onHit), the same simplification precedent as Leona Sunlight/Warwick P elsewhere in this project; in reality a leg can be on cooldown and miss a trigger, so this is an upper-bound approximation, not an exact per-attack guarantee.

_noteW: Purge. Live wiki (2026-07-10): 'Modified Physical Damage: 12 (+ 20 / 23.5 / 27 / 30.5 / 34% AD)' PER SHOT -- matches BIN DamagePerShot = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=12) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 => BONUS AD, ADRatioTT)[0.20,0.235,0.27,0.305,0.34 at ranks 1-5]. Purge fires up to WAttacksPerSecond=3 shots/sec for Duration=4s (before max rank, where it instead becomes an indefinite toggle). The wiki's own Notes section states explicitly: 'Before maximum rank, if continuously attacking without being interrupted or interrupting or canceling the cast, Urgot will attack 13 times' -- used directly as count=13 (one full non-toggle-rank W channel). At max rank (toggle, unlimited duration) this undercounts real total damage, a documented simplification consistent with this project's 'count = one full landed cast' convention -- a toggled indefinite W has no finite 'full duration' to model. OnHitDamageReduction (50%) reduces on-hit EFFECTS (e.g. item procs) during Purge, not DamagePerShot's own number, which is already the fully modified per-shot value.

_noteR: Fear Beyond Death. Live wiki (2026-07-10): initial chem-drill 'Physical Damage: 100 / 225 / 350 (+ 50% bonus AD)' -- matches BIN RCalculatedDamage = NamedDataValue(RBaseDamage)[100,225,350 at ranks 1-3] + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 => BONUS AD, RBonusADRatio=0.5). Confirmed correct (prior auto-pick was right). The RECAST ('Mercy') is a guaranteed EXECUTE/kill once the leashed target is reeled in below RHealthThreshold=25% max HP (or would otherwise die from the initial hit) -- not a formula-scaling number but a boolean kill condition, so no second hit is curated for it (curating one would mean fabricating a number the BIN does not express as a plain scaling formula). Tagged BurstCeiling: the initial hit plus the guaranteed-execute recast together represent Urgot's single highest realistic burst-damage / kill-securing contribution. Tagged Execute for the recast's hard-threshold kill mechanic, distinct from a smooth missing-HP scale.
